terms.gloss: a street for people on foot
terms.comment: A description, on the pattern of trānsitus peditum for a pedestrian crossing. We have found no term for a street closed to traffic in Lewis & Short, Traupman, Morgan–Owens, or Levi–Bini. Pedes is the walker (Traupman); its plural also means foot soldiers, which a street does not confuse. To say it in a sentence, say what happens there: nūlla vehicula commeant.

phrases.latin: Hāc viā nūlla vehicula commeant; licet currere.
phrases.english: No cars come along this street; you can run.

sources: Lewis & Short: pedes · Lewis & Short: commeo
